title: Risk Burn-Down
claim_boundary: This register records local risk decisions for the RC. It does not prove native GUI, hosted CI, signing, public release, or hardware failure behavior.
decision_policy: A risk is mitigated only by executable local evidence; unavailable gates remain explicitly accepted or deferred with an owner.

risks.risk: Worldbuilding capabilities may be exposed beyond their verified integration boundary during RC validation.
risks.mitigation: Keep scope frozen to F1-F29, default flags OFF, and preserve deferred Wave 2 capabilities behind the shared kill switch.
risks.residual_risk: Feature-level rollout isolation is incomplete for deferred features using the shared flag.

risks.risk: Schema or contract evolution could make an existing project unreadable or unsafe to migrate.
risks.mitigation: Freeze format and contract versions, reject unsupported future versions, require backup before forward migration, and keep downgrade as a documented boundary.
risks.residual_risk: A complete reference-project migration rehearsal is still pending in step 112.27.

risks.risk: Private worldbuilding or workspace data could cross ownership or export boundaries.
risks.mitigation: Enforce workspace ownership and permission projections, use deny-by-default sharing/redaction contracts, and preserve the explicit no-public-release boundary.
risks.residual_risk: Dependency scanning and full release export threat-model evidence remain later-gate work.

risks.risk: Large graph, timeline, media, or world datasets may exceed responsiveness or storage budgets.
risks.mitigation: Retain bounded background-job/performance primitives and require measured budgets in the dedicated performance and memory gates before release.
risks.residual_risk: No Sprint 112 large-project benchmark result is claimed by this register.

risks.risk: Keyboard, focus, scaling, screen-reader, and nonvisual paths may regress across the integrated surfaces.
risks.mitigation: Keep accessibility and localization as explicit release gates; preserve the existing local verification matrix and do not infer native assistive-technology certification from widget tests.
risks.residual_risk: Native screen-reader and full input-mode coverage are not available in this local cron gate.

risks.risk: Local green tests may be mistaken for hosted CI, signed artifact, platform, or public-release compatibility.
risks.mitigation: Label all evidence VERIFIED-LOCAL, keep hosted CI/signing/native boundaries explicit, and block release claims until the applicable gates produce evidence.
risks.residual_risk: Hosted CI billing and native release validation remain unavailable in this run.
